title: Review findings
description: One document per independent review context and pinned head. Consumers recompute the effective verdict and never trust a stored verdict or count: an invalid document, a stored blocked verdict or a contract row with a null field is blocked; otherwise any main-path or money finding, or a stored revise, is revise; otherwise approve.

verdict.description: approve: no main-path or money finding. revise: at least one. blocked: the context could not judge; the summary names the missing evidence.

lenses.description: Lenses applied in this context, from the project's risk routing. Each finding's lens is one of these.

repository.description: Resolved repository identity, such as host/owner/name.

pullRequest.description: Pull request number or URL, when one exists.

head.description: Pinned head commit the review read.

base.description: Pinned base commit the diff was taken against.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on the judgment. For blocked, the exact missing evidence.

hygiene.description: Required from the general lens. Each category is pass or the ids of its findings; silence is not a pass.

contracts.description: Required from the contract lens: one row per changed REST, stream, ABI or indexer boundary.

uncovered.description: Areas, journeys or files not reviewed, each with its reason. An empty list claims full coverage of the routed scope.

lens.description: general, contract, money or a project lens that has its own read-only role file.

id.description: Stable within the audit, such as money-1. Replies and repair reviews cite it.

impact.description: main-path: breaks a primary user, operator, administrator, release or credible adversary journey, including authorization and secret boundaries. money: duplicate or wrong submission, wrong amount, price, fee or balance, or stuck or lost funds. deferred: anything else; never blocks.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or the reviewed input name such as plan.md.

line.description: First relevant line at the pinned head; null only for a missing file or a whole-file finding.

trigger.description: Ordered user actions or inputs on the normal journey that produce the defect. For a deferred finding, the sequence that would be needed.

mechanism.description: How the code fails, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: file:line citations, command output or quoted contract text proving the mechanism.

repair.description: Smallest safe repair direction. The implementation owner decides the change.

contractRow.description: A null field marks an unresolved contract fact and makes the document blocked.

boundary.description: Operation, channel, function, event or entity; its authoritative artifact; the exact caller.
